# FooterActions

FooterActions — 4-track footer layout for Modal, Panel and a multi-step task's footer. Divides the footer into 4 equal tracks separated by `--inline-md`. Every filled action button is cloned at `spacing="spacious"` (48) with `shouldFitContainer`. A leading action hugs the left edge without taking a filled track and is always drawn as a link (`link`, or `danger-link` for a destructive one), and containers up to 400 wide split a single action across the full width via `@container (max-width: 400px)`.

**Import:** `import { FooterActions } from '@/components';`

**Used in:** Card (`ds guide card`)

**Governed by:** Common actions (`ds guide common-actions`)

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/FooterActions/FooterActions.jsx`

## Usage

Use `FooterActions` inside Modal, Panel (`PanelFooter`) and the multi-step task footer to place one to three filled `Button` actions on a four-track grid with an optional leading action. Secondary buttons draw the `default` soft neutral fill (`--ds-background-neutral`) with no outline so pairs balance without heavy borders.

What the footer finishes picks its layout, and this component is the answer for a Modal, a Panel and a multi-step task only. A form on a page, a Card and a Popup keep buttons that hug their labels; see the footer rule on Common actions. An action that leaves is a link and an action that does something is a button, so the leading slot is always a `link` or a `danger-link`, and Cancel never appears here.

1. **Four equal tracks.** `FooterActions` divides the width inside container padding into four equal tracks separated by `--inline-md`; every filled track button is cloned with `spacing="spacious"` (`48` high) and `shouldFitContainer`.
2. **One action.** Sits in the right half (tracks `3` and `4`). A single action fills the full width (all four tracks) only when the footer itself is `400` px wide or less (`@container (max-width: 400px)`) and there is no leading action.
3. **Two actions.** Split `50/50` across tracks `1`–`2` and `3`–`4`: secondary on the left in the `default` soft neutral fill (`--ds-background-neutral`), `primary` on the right.
4. **Three actions.** Take one quarter each in tracks `2`, `3` and `4`; only the rightmost is `primary`.
5. **Leading action.** The leading slot holds only a side action that is not one of the footer's two outcomes: a destructive action such as "Delete", or a `link` that leaves the task, such as "Save and exit". It is always drawn as text with no fill: a `danger` action there becomes a `danger-link`, and any other leading action a `link`. It hugs the left content edge when it is the first child (of two or more) or is passed as `leadingAction`. It is never "Not now", "Cancel" or "Back". An action that declines or postpones ("Not now", "Skip", "Keep editing", "Save for later") is a `default` secondary in the left half, beside the primary. Filled actions sit in tracks `3`–`4` (one filled), `3` and `4` (two filled), or `2`, `3` and `4` (three filled, clamping the leading action to track `1`).
6. **Destructive confirmations.** Place the safer alternative (`default` secondary, such as "Archive instead") on the left and the `danger` action as the rightmost child, splitting `50/50` across tracks `1`–`2` and `3`–`4`.
7. **No Cancel in footers.** `Modal` and `Panel` already carry a corner close button, so footers name real outcomes ("Discard", "Save", never Cancel).
8. **Steps.** In a multi-step flow, "Back" (`default`) and "Next" (`primary`) split `50/50` across tracks `1`–`2` and `3`–`4`.

### Hug or fill

Buttons fill in only two places: filled tracks inside `FooterActions`, and a single action when the footer itself is `400` px wide or less with no leading action. Everywhere else they hug their label.

| Surface | Buttons | Story |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Page header | `default` 32; at most one `primary`, rightmost | Layout/PageHeader |
| Card or section header | `subtle` `compact` text button and/or `subtle` icon button | Card, Section |
| Table toolbar | `compact`; `subtle` secondary, `primary` rightmost | Patterns/Table |
| Table row | `subtle` icon buttons or one `subtle` `compact` text action; never filled | Table template, DynamicTable |
| Empty state | centered; `default` 32 on a page, `compact` 24 in a card | Messaging/EmptyState, Docs/Empty |
| Banner and Flag | `subtle` `compact` text actions after the message | Messaging/Banner, Messaging/Flag |
| Button group | related actions in a spaced row; items hug their labels | Navigation/ButtonGroup |
| Inline with a field | same height as the field, `default` appearance | Docs/Forms |

## Alternatives

- For single-page or full-page forms where buttons hug their labels on the left, use `Button`.
- For switching between views of the same content, use `SegmentedControl`. For a spaced row of related action buttons, use `ButtonGroup`.

## Best practices

### Keep the primary action on the right. {#keep-the-primary-action-on-the-right}

Only the rightmost filled button carries the `primary` (or `danger`) appearance; secondary actions sit to its left in the `default` soft neutral fill.

Do: Secondary on the left, primary on the right.
Don't: Two primary buttons competing in the same footer.

### Put a side action in the leading slot, and a declining action in the left half. {#put-a-side-action-in-the-leading-slot-and-a-declining-action-in-the-left-half}

The leading slot holds a `danger` destructive action or a `link` that leaves the task. A declining action such as "Not now" is a `default` secondary, left of the primary.

Do: A destructive side action hugs the left edge while the two outcomes sit in the rightmost tracks.
Don't: "Not now" in the leading slot instead of the left half.

### Pair a destructive confirmation with a safer alternative. {#pair-a-destructive-confirmation-with-a-safer-alternative}

Put the safer alternative in the left half and the `danger` action rightmost; a `danger` button placed first of two moves to the leading slot instead, drawn as a `danger-link`.

Do: Safer alternative on the left and danger rightmost, splitting equally across both halves.
Don't: Danger placed first of two moves to the leading slot instead of being the confirmation.

### Omit Cancel when the corner close button dismisses. {#omit-cancel-when-the-corner-close-button-dismisses}

`Modal` and `Panel` already provide a corner close control, so the footer names the real secondary outcome (`Discard`, `Keep editing`, `Archive instead`), as a `default` secondary in the left half, rather than a generic Cancel.

Do: Real verbs split equally across both halves of the footer.
Don't: Default-height hugging buttons and a Cancel label that duplicates the corner close button.

### Split Back and Next across the footer in multi-step flows. {#split-back-and-next-across-the-footer-in-multi-step-flows}

Keep `Back` in the `default` appearance so the step pair splits `50/50` across both halves rather than moving `Back` to the leading slot.

Do: Back in the left half and Next in the right half, splitting the footer equally.
Don't: Back in the leading slot, so Next stands alone instead of an equal step pair.

### Let `FooterActions` buttons with long labels end in an ellipsis. {#let-footeractions-buttons-with-long-labels-end-in-an-ellipsis}

The buttons keep their height and the footer keeps to its well. See [Overflow](?path=/docs/patterns-states-overflow--docs).

## Accessibility

- **Focus order follows reading order.** The leading action receives focus first, followed by the secondary actions and the rightmost primary action.
- **Full-track hit targets.** Every filled action uses `spacing="spacious"` (`48`) and fills its track.

## Parts

1. **Grid container.** Four equal tracks separated by `--inline-md`, with `container-type: inline-size` so footers `400` px wide or narrower adapt automatically.
2. **Leading action** (`leadingAction`, or the first child of two or more when it is a `danger` action or a link). A side action, never one of the two outcomes. Hugs the left content edge and never stretches across a filled track.
3. **Filled actions.** One to three `Button` children cloned at `spacing="spacious"` (`48`) with `shouldFitContainer`.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Wide (over 400 px) | 1 filled button takes tracks 3–4; 2 split tracks 1–2 and 3–4; 3 take tracks 2, 3 and 4. |
| Narrow (400 px and below) | Measured on the footer itself by `@container (max-width: 400px)`: a single action with no leading action spans all 4 tracks. |
| Leading action | Hugs its label on the left edge when passed as `leadingAction` or placed as the first child of two or more, while filled actions take the rightmost tracks. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 48: `--footer-height`. |
| Track gap | `--inline-md` between the 4 equal tracks. |
| Link leading action | `--ds-link` label and `--ds-icon-brand` icon with no fill, underlined on hover and `--ds-link-pressed` when pressed. Its start padding is `0`, so the text sits on the content edge. |
| Danger-link leading action | `--ds-text-danger` label and `--ds-icon-danger` icon with no fill, underlined on hover and `--ds-text-danger-bolder` when pressed. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the secondary action for what it does: "Discard", "Save draft", "Archive instead". | Add a generic "Cancel" button beside the corner close button. |
| Keep labels to two or three words so they fit a single track without truncating. | Write sentence-length button labels in a 4-track footer. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `leadingAction` | node | — | Optional leading action hugging the left content edge without taking a filled track. It is drawn as a `link`, or a `danger-link` when it is a `danger` action. |
| `children` | node | — | Filled action buttons placed across the 4 tracks. |
| `className` | string | — | Extra class names added to the footer grid container. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline style overrides on the footer grid container. |
